Turn off audio processing for these earphones?
The audio service of the phone restarts, so anything playing right now goes quiet for a few seconds. Bluetooth stays connected, and your equaliser settings are kept either way.
Applying. The sound comes back in a few seconds.

It did not finish in time and was stopped. The audio service may still be restarting. Check again in a moment.
Nothing was changed: the app sent something the module could not read. This is a fault in the app.
Nothing was changed: the audio processing module has not started. Restart the phone, then try again.

The audio service did not come back. Restart the phone.
It failed in a way this version of the app does not know about (code %1$d).
Different earphones are connected right now, so what you change here does not reach the sound yet. Connect these earphones and it is applied.
More than one set of earphone effects is running, and the app cannot tell which one belongs to these earphones, so nothing was sent. Disconnect the other earphones, then change something here again.
These settings have not reached the sound yet. Play something on these earphones, or open this app again.
These settings did not reach the sound: root access was refused, or this phone has no root manager. Allow Codec Anchor in your root manager.
These settings did not reach the sound: the audio processing module is not running. Restart the phone.
These settings did not reach the sound: the app and the audio processing module are different versions. Update both to the same version, then restart the phone.

Sending these settings did not finish in time and was stopped.
These settings did not reach the sound: the app built the request wrongly. This is a fault in the app.

Every band moves to one of the fixed frequencies of the graphic equaliser and its Q is set to match. The shape of the curve is kept as closely as it can be, but the frequencies and Q values you have now are lost.
Every gain and the manual preamp go back to 0 dB, so the equaliser stops changing the sound. The bands stay where they are, but the curve you have now is lost unless it has been saved as a preset.
Removes \"%1$s\". What is already set on your earphones stays as it is.
Reads a ParametricEQ.txt or GraphicEQ.txt from AutoEQ and replaces the settings above.

Around 25 to 40 questions, 10 to 15 minutes. You can stop at any time and continue later.
